title: India's Digital Divide — Map 3: Gender & Progress
credit: Data: NFHS-6 · Boundaries: Government of India

beats.say: And then there's the quietest divide of all. Gender.
Nationally, eighty percent of men use the internet — against sixty-four percent of women. A sixteen point gap, everywhere on the map.
Brighter here means a bigger gender gap.

stops.say: Karnataka — a twenty-six point gender gap.
Telangana, twenty-two. Southern states lead their own men least of all.
Odisha, twenty-one. The list is long.
But Goa — the gap nearly disappears. Three points the other way. Women match men.

beats.say: Yet in one survey cycle, the women's figure nearly doubled — from thirty-three to sixty-four percent. The fastest gains are in the states that were furthest behind.
